title: BrickBench: Evaluating Agentic Brick Design
why_read: A novel, well-scoped benchmark testing whether AI agents can design physically buildable LEGO sets, interesting as a constraint-reasoning testbed.
analysis: BrickBench asks AI agents to design LEGO-style brick assemblies from text prompts, requiring them to pick real parts from a library and satisfy both physical buildability and semantic intent. This is a creative benchmark for testing spatial and constraint reasoning in agents, going beyond typical language or code benchmarks into a domain with hard physical validity checks. The finding that current agents meet basic validity requirements but still fall short of human designs is a believable, modest result rather than a breakthrough.
